title: SOP-SSFCM: spatial opinion-pooling semi-supervised fuzzy c-means (reference implementation)
description: NumPy reference implementation accompanying the manuscript Semi-supervised fuzzy c-means with spatial opinion pooling of classifier probabilities for hyperspectral images with few labeled samples. Implements SOP-SSFCM, a semi-supervised fuzzy c-means whose guidance term carries a fixed spatial prior obtained as the logarithmic opinion pool of classifier class probabilities over the pixel neighbourhood, the unpooled control (r = 0), the measured-scale rule for the guidance weight, and the scripts that download the six public hyperspectral scenes (with SHA-256 checksums), regenerate the label sets from their seeds and reproduce the benchmark.
